name: Kyoushi-tachi no Himitsu no Houkago
original_name: 教師たちの秘密の放課後
source:
When the bell rings, your secret begins... Your all-boys school and the neighboring all-girls school are combining! And your new coworkers include five gorgeous men! But there's a new school rule: No love allowed, and that does for both teachers and students... Ready to break the rules?

[From Love 365 app]
translation:
当铃声响起时，你的秘密就开始了……你的男校和邻近的女校正在合并！你的新同事包括五位帅气的男人！但是有一条新的校规：不允许有爱，这对老师和学生来说都是如此……准备好打破规则了吗？

[来自爱365应用]
